title: Blood type and Rh factor
what: This test shows your blood type and Rh factor: positive or negative. Blood is taken from a vein or a finger.
why: Before surgery, during pregnancy or when planning one, before a blood transfusion, and for medical records and documents.
duration: taking the blood takes 1 to 3 minutes
tell_doctor: If you have had a blood transfusion, especially recently
If your blood type was tested before, tell them the result

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no special preparation is needed. If you are having other tests at the same time, come fasting as your clinic says.

prepare.title: Water
prepare.text: Drink a glass of plain water. This makes it easier to take blood.

steps: You are asked to sit down and say your full name, so the tube is labeled correctly
The nurse takes blood from a vein or a finger
A cotton ball is put on the spot
In the lab, the blood is mixed with special reagents to see the result
feel: Sometimes a small bruise stays after a vein draw
after: Press the cotton ball for a few minutes
You can go about your day right away
The result is usually ready the same day or the next day
Your blood type does not change in your lifetime. Keep the result

faq.a: No. Blood type and Rh are set from birth and do not change. The exception is rare cases after a bone marrow transplant.

faq.q: Why do pregnant women need to know their Rh factor?
faq.a: If the mother is Rh negative and the baby is Rh positive, special monitoring is needed. The doctor will tell you which tests come next.

faq.q: Why is my blood type checked again before surgery?
faq.a: It is the safety rule. Before a transfusion, blood is always checked again, even if the type is known.
